reasoning_content: Nginx is configured and serving arelorian on port 3000. Let me check the nginx config to see where it's proxying to.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check arelorian nginx config
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cat /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/arelorian")
print("Config:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
